synopsis: Chapter 5 reports that Para-Lane lidar mapping achieved 1.3 cm mean absolute error on road scenes after pose refinement or optimisation [f3721, f3858, f3804]. The fuller account describes a reduction in map thickness error from 4.5 cm to 1.3 cm [f3804]. The glossary repeats the 1.3 cm laser-scanning road-scene result, rather than providing separate validation [f13138]. The supplied evidence is on-road; these facts do not establish equivalent accuracy for heavy off-road job sites [f3721, f13138, f3858, f3804].
